title: Ho Chi Minh City walk
duration: A center walk. Check on arrival.
summary: The cathedral square, the post office opposite, Nguyễn Huệ at sundown, the Reunification Palace, and Bến Thành.

stops.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
stops.note: Look at the cathedral from the square in the morning.

stops.name: Central Post Office
stops.note: Step into the hall opposite the cathedral for the maps by the door.

stops.name: Nguyen Hue
stops.note: Stroll the paving from City Hall to the river at sundown.

stops.name: Reunification Palace
stops.note: Walk the halls and the basement, open 07:00–18:00.

stops.name: Ben Thanh Market
stops.note: Walk the aisles to the food end of the hall, where the stalls cook bánh xèo and bánh mì.

seoTitle: A center walk in Ho Chi Minh City
seoDescription: Cathedral, post office, Nguyễn Huệ, the Reunification Palace, and Bến Thành on one center walk.
